name: Zest
tagline: Keep your to-dos in order and see what you finish
description:
Zest is a to-do app for the everyday list: shopping, chores, work, anything you need to remember. Sort tasks into colour-coded categories, break the big ones into subtasks, give them priorities and tags, and pin whatever matters most to the top.

Reminders arrive on time, and you can mark a task done or snooze it straight from the notification without opening the app. A calendar view shows what is coming up and a year-long heatmap shows what you have already finished. Backups can be made by hand or on a daily, weekly or monthly schedule into a folder you pick. It follows your wallpaper colours, has a pure black theme for OLED screens, and speaks 16 languages.

Everything stays on your phone. There is no account and no sync between devices, so a backup file is how you move your lists somewhere else.
